    The year 2026 is highlighted by
    major global events including the FIFA World Cup in North America, the Winter Olympics in Italy, and the 250th anniversary of American independence. Economically, U.S. growth is projected to accelerate, while scientifically, major space and health milestones are scheduled. 
    Key 2026 Events & Highlights: 
    • Sports: FIFA World Cup (Canada, Mexico, USA), Winter Olympics and Paralympics (Italy), 2026 NFL Draft.
    • Space & Science: NASA Artemis II launch (expected April), World Health Day "Stand with Science" campaign.
    • USA 250th Anniversary: Year-long commemoration of American freedom and independence.
    • Lunar Events: Total lunar eclipse (March 2/3), total solar eclipse (August 12), and super moons.
    • Culture: Lunar New Year (Year of the Fire Horse).
    • Economy: U.S. growth projected to accelerate, with core inflation potentially falling to 2%.
    • Significant Dates: Federal holidays include New Year's Day (Thursday) and July 4th (Friday).
    • Championships: Michigan wins NCAA men's basketball title. 
    Astronomy & Nature 
    • Total Lunar Eclipse (Blood Moon): March 2-3, 2026.
    • Total Solar Eclipse: August 12, 2026 (visible in Greenland, Iceland, Spain).
    • Supermoons: November 25 and Christmas Eve. 
    Lunar New Year (Feb 17, 2026) 
    • The year aligns under the Fire Horse, a powerful and energetic year, often associated with a pure fire element, which signifies a strong and fiery period according to tradition.
